mainEntity.name: How can I make my primary bathroom more accessible or age-in-place friendly?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a primary bathroom more accessible, consider features like zero-threshold showers, grab bars, comfort-height toilets, and wider doorways. Incorporating non-slip flooring and ample lighting can also significantly improve safety. For age-in-place design, planning for future needs, such as space for a bench in the shower or reinforced walls for potential grab bar installation, is beneficial. We can integrate these elements seamlessly into your remodel, ensuring both functionality and aesthetic appeal for long-term comfort.
acceptedAnswer.description: Enhance accessibility with zero-threshold showers, grab bars, comfort-height toilets, and non-slip flooring for an age-in-place friendly design.
